subject: Trust portal: rolling reviewer reissue and audit-window anchor
messages:
From: Sarah Bell <sarah.bell@triad-audit.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II access — staggered reviewer cohorts and evidence window

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Triad will be running a concurrent review for two external stakeholders for Northbridge's integration review (one technical reviewer + one legal reviewer). Their schedules don't fully overlap, so we wanted to request staggered portal access rather than a single long window.

Request summary: 
- Two reviewer cohorts: Technical (7/25–7/29) and Legal (7/30–8/03).
- Each cohort needs view + limited-download for SOC 2 Type II evidence (reports, control matrices, sample logs).
- A short bridge letter confirming audit period (fiscal 2027: 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31) and confirming no major control exceptions since report issuance

Can you confirm whether your trust portal supports: 
1) Rolling access issuance (two one-week windows tied to separate reviewer emails).
2) Audit-period anchor (a signed bridge letter we can attach to our report package).
3) IP allowlist for Triad reviewers so SSO links do not break during MFA.

I've attached a one-page access checklist and a template bridge-letter (for your convenience). If rolling windows are easier implemented as two separate one-time SSO links, that works.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our kickoff with Northbridge is scheduled for 7/24 and we need access patterns finalized before then.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Bell
Senior Audit Manager, Triad Audit
Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_request_form.pdf (pdf), bridge-letter-draft.docx (docx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bell <sarah.bell@triad-audit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II access — staggered reviewer cohorts and evidence window

Sarah —

Thanks for the clear ask and the templates. We can absolutely support staggered one-time SSO links scoped per reviewer email. Summary of our approach: 

- We will provision two ephemeral reviewer links (7-day windows) and attach a bridge letter.
- Bridge letter: legal will sign the standard template after we confirm the exact audit period language.
- IP allowlist: we can add Triad's reviewer IP ranges to prevent SSO prompts; need the CIDR blocks from you.
- Download policy: limited to pre-approved attachments; we will also flag the SOC 2 Type II PDF as view+download for both cohorts.

Action items for Triad: provide the reviewer emails for each cohort and the IP ranges.
Action items for Redwood: we will prepare the two one-time SSO links, sign the bridge letter, and stage the evidence bundle in the portal by 7/23.

Kimberly and Ben — looping you in for the bridge-letter signoff and to schedule the staging/export of the evidence bundle. Marissa, FYI on potential multi-cohort access pattern (this might be useful for future audits).

I'll confirm once the links are ready.

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference
